title: Fresh guides for running image models on RTX 5090s
summary:
A garden-maintenance day: clearer self-hosting guides, live model discovery, stronger shared-infrastructure guardrails, and a fresh round of community updates.

New Vast.ai deployment guides cover Flux, Z-Image, and TwinFlow on RTX 5090 hardware, giving self-hosters a more direct path from rented GPU to image endpoint.

The MCP integration dropped its model cache and now fetches available models directly from the API, so connected tools see a more current model catalog without cache archaeology.

A new LLM-based abuse detection script, Microbe tier support, dedicated refill-cron credentials, and dashboard alerting tighten the operational loop around keeping the commons usable.
